notes:
Build C adds full-size cutting templates for custom drawn blocks.

- Choose a drawn-piece seam allowance in Make, then use Make Template.
- Templates include solid cutting lines, dashed sewing lines, piece and fabric labels, seam matching marks, grain guidance and calibration squares. Mirrored printing is available.
- Cutting lists and conservative fabric blanks come from the same geometry as the templates. Supported rectangles have exact rotary dimensions.
- Save and reopen custom seam settings without changing the exact drawing. An explicit custom seam setting uses project format 5; earlier project formats remain supported by this version.
- Signed in-app updates remain available through Help → Check for Updates → Preview / Development.

Construction is intentionally conservative: ambiguous or collapsing seam allowances are refused. Automatic sewing order and foundation sections, DXF and cutter/laser toolpaths are not included. Print at Actual Size and measure the calibration square before cutting; physical print-and-sew acceptance is still needed.

Application source remains private. This public release contains the Windows installer and its update signature only.
